title: Say Aturon Lider na Sakey a Bansa
intro: Diad panaon na baleg ya angat tan inkaandi-ilalo parad sakey a totoo, sakey a madibinon tinuro so ginawa. Sayan indibidual, ya ag-inimano na dakel ed gapo, et pinili nen Allah ya mangidaulo na sakey a bansa sumpad makapataktakot a kalaban. Say istorya ra et sakey a paneknek ed pakayari na pananisia tan say kakabatan ed benegan na madibinon ganggan, ya mangipapanengneng ya say tuan liderato et aglawas naromog ed saray iilaloan a pasen.
clues: Pinili ak nen Allah ya magmaliw ya lider na totook nen nananap ira na manuley ya milaban ed gagala To.
Diad gapo et kinuwestiyon na totook so inkaturo ko, ta inisip dan mas makanepegan so arum lapud kayamanan odino kapolian da.
Say tanda na manepeg a panangidaulo ko et say impawil na sakey a sagradon kaban, a walaan na saray relikya na saray akaunan propeta, ya angitarok na kareenan.
Inwanwan ko so armada ko ed sakey ya ilog, a diman ko sinubok so katutulok da diad impangisebel ko ed sikara ya oninum na masulok nen sakey a kutsara na danum.
Anggaman ed daiset a bilang na saramay nansiansian mapekder kayari na subok, nipaarap kami ed sakey a mabiskeg a mibabakal tan say armada ra.
Diad silong na panangidaulo ko, sakey a kalangweran ya indibidual manlapud armada ko, ya aliwan bantog a mibabakal, so makpel ya angarap tan analo ed makapataktakot a kampeon na kalaban.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say inkaturo bilang lider sumpad sakey a higante
Say delap ya amaknol ed dalin
trial.answer: Say inkaturo bilang lider sumpad sakey a higante

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Niletneg so sakey a panarian a walaan na baleg a kayamanan tan pakayari.
Nalner iray totoo ed baleg a delap.
Say kampeon na kalaban et atalo, tan inikdan nen Allah na pananalo.
Say baleg a kelang so amairap ed dalin ed loob na dakel a taon.
Say lider et inakmon na sakey a baleg a pinalsa.
outcome.answer: Say kampeon na kalaban et atalo, tan inikdan nen Allah na pananalo.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
